sources.entry: unbraid - Per-app VPN client. Each app can use its own exit or skip the VPN, while Tailscale stays on. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/quiet-crafts/unbraid-mac) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.name: unbraid
summary.one_liner: unbraid is a free, open-source split tunneling VPN client for Android and Mac that routes each app through its own VPN exit, direct connection, or block, with Tailscale running alongside.
use_cases: Send banking apps around the VPN while other apps use it
Run different apps through VPN exits in different countries
Use Tailscale and a commercial VPN on the same device
Reach home devices like a NAS or printer from a VPN-routed phone or Mac
Block specific apps from getting any internet connection
summary.what_it_does: unbraid is a single VPN app that holds several VPN connections open at once, letting each app or website use its own route: a specific provider and country, the normal connection (Direct), or no connection (Blocked). Routes can use different providers such as NordVPN, Mullvad, Proton VPN, AirVPN, or your own server. Tailscale runs inside the app, so apps can reach your tailnet while their internet goes through the chosen exit, without installing the Tailscale app. The Android and Mac versions include per-app and per-route statistics that are off by default and stay on the device, plus home-screen or menu bar widgets and quick settings controls. unbraid itself provides no VPN servers; you bring a supported provider account or your own server.
notable: Several VPN connections open at once, each app or website on its own exit
Tailscale and Headscale run inside the app alongside VPN exits
Open source under GPL-3.0 with no unbraid account and no analytics
Mac version requires macOS 26 or later
caveats: Requires your own VPN provider account or server; provider device and connection limits still apply
Mac version requires macOS 26 or later
Donations are not open yet; page describes the app as free with no paid features
